scope: Whole mainspace wikitext articles, complete independently bounded literal wikitables, outside protected examples and calculated structures.

rules.emptyRowMarkers: Only attribute-free repeated markers separated by whitespace and attribute-free final markers. Rows containing actual cells, comments or attributes are never called empty.
rules.missingAttributeBars: Only an entire fully quoted recognized cell-attribute prefix containing scope, rowspan or colspan, followed by a nonempty static label. A unique separator is inserted. Unknown attributes, calculated labels and ambiguous quoted content are refused.
rules.typographicSpanQuotes: Only paired typographic quotation marks enclosing a positive decimal literal span of one through three digits in an explicit cell-attribute zone. Other quotes, numbers and cell contents remain exact.
rules.mixedClosers: An isolated HTML closing table tag can close one unmatched literal wikitable only when no HTML table tags, nesting or calculated structures occur inside and a complete regular grid is verified.
rules.deepLeafScopes: Only three or four consecutive header tiers with noncrossing nested colspan partitions and at least one actual subdivision. Individual final headers receive scope=col. Upper grouping cells remain exact. Rowspan, custom identifiers, explicit header associations and conflicting scope are refused.

independentObjects: Validation is performed on each complete table. A separately malformed tail is retained byte for byte and is not treated as evidence that the complete table is malformed.
jointRepairs: All new finite syntax corrections in one table form one atomic source-bound transaction, with local edit and before/after hash evidence. Existing numeric quote and identical-attribute rules may finish that same validated table.
conservation: No row, column, cell, value, label, citation, image, link, caption, sort key, table width or data record is invented or removed. Redundant markers contain no data. Every byte outside a syntax transaction remains unchanged.
notImplemented: Filling missing cells or guessing spans from uneven row lengths
Moving captions based only on their source position
Blanket widths, scroll wrappers or mobile layout changes
anonymousParserObservation: Read-only native parsing confirmed that repeated attribute-free row markers and an attribute-free final marker produce no extra tr or cell element. Unseparated scope attributes are displayed as cell text. These observations guide finite fixtures rather than authorize broad reconstruction.
